cells.gaps: No source states the bill tabled, passed or enacted; the cabinet committee on legislation approved it and sent it to the justice ministry (NAM-018, March 2026), and on 13 July 2026 the minister said it was being finalised (NAM-002). NAM-001 (an opposition MP, August 2026) says no statute exists. The authority is named only in the 2020 and 2022 drafts; no regulations or application held.
cells.note: The bill is still a draft; no source puts it before parliament, so the rung is 2 and the stage 3 test (enacted) is unmet. The cabinet committee's approval in March 2026 is the advancing event.
